onboarding1_body: Find rare old pieces, each one with its own story.
onboarding2_body: Browse paintings and handmade art from local artists.
onboarding3_body: Pick what you love and order it in a few taps.
product_clock_desc: A wooden wall clock from the 1950s. It still works and chimes every hour.
product_painting_desc: A hand-painted landscape of an old village, in a carved golden frame.
product_lamp_desc: A traditional brass lamp with hand-cut patterns that make beautiful shadows.
product_projector_desc: An Elmo ST-1200HD sound film projector from the 1970s, with both reels. A rare piece for movie lovers.
product_shakwa_desc: A traditional shakwa made from goat hide, once used to churn milk into butter. It sits on a hand-woven striped mat.
product_camels_desc: A pair of handmade camel figurines covered in leather, with small saddles and reins.
